evidence: src/infrastructure/InMemoryOrderRepository.ts: class InMemoryOrderRepository implements OrderRepository, so it is an infrastructure adapter for a domain port
save(order) calls this.store.set(order.id, order), which is plain persistence
findById and findAll only read from the in-memory Map
findByState filters with order.state === state, which is a repository query predicate and not business logic
parsedVerdict.reasoning: InMemoryOrderRepository is an infrastructure adapter. It implements the domain OrderRepository port using an in-memory Map. Every method is a persistence concern: save stores an order by id, findById looks one up, findAll lists them all, and findByState filters them. The equality filter in findByState is an ordinary repository query, not a business rule. It makes no domain decisions, does no state transitions, runs no validation and does no orchestration. So the file's responsibilities fit the infrastructure layer.
